outputs.total: no_hole + Q_h*hole, u = u(no_hole) + |Q_h| u(hole); formed by the test in rationals

method.response: Im F = L (E1) with the hard gap; g = 0: E4b; g > 0: Re F by E4a, partial fractions of the retained band
method.equations: Simonsen et al. (1997) Eqs. (13)-(18), theta = 0, typed from docs/M1_EQUATION_MAP.md 4.1
method.route_a: closed-form depth average derived by hand (compact_laplace); adaptive composite 24-point Gauss-Legendre in ln k_parallel, run A 50 digits, run B 80 digits with every panel halved; value = run B
method.route_b: depth quadrature of the printed fixed-depth factors (the elementary depth factors 1, u, |u|^2 and (e^{-iba}-e^{-ka})(e^{iba}-e^{-ka}) are integrated numerically and the depth-independent factors of the printed braces are applied afterwards; the identity is checked pointwise in self_checks; the depth quadrature uses fixed-point integers with 256 fractional bits and the addition theorems of the exponentials inside a region of equal panels, checked against a direct mpf evaluation in self_checks; and the whole printed pieces are integrated for the cases of route_b_whole_pieces_check): composite Gauss-Legendre on panels cut by the decay rates p+2k, p+k, p and the phase b*a, up to exp(-52); on the accepted parent panels of run A, 50 digits
method.v1_depth_quadrature: t = p*a panels of size 10/(rate+b), 24 points, tail 64/p; changes: 48 points with size 20, size 7, tail 80/p; digits raised by 2*log10(p/min(k,b)) for the cancellations
method.groups: full printed braces with the hole factor kept apart, transformed mode by mode (not a sum of the terms, not route a)
method.u_term: |a-b| + 2*|A-B| + residual(A) + max(order, phase, tail changes) + decimal rounding
method.u_group: |group - sum of route-b terms| + 2*|A-B| + residual(A) + sum of route-b changes of the members + decimal rounding
method.term_13a_independent: V3: (a) L(0,T) log(q+/q-)/(pi a0 E0) without dispersion; (b) bulk integral over the total momentum for k_total with dispersion
method.limits: mode coefficients c0, cs, cd of G_j(a) from the printed factors (design 2.2); G0 = Int(c0+Re cs+cd), envelope = Int(|s cs|+2k|cd|), G_inf = Int c0, A1 = Int(Re(cs/s)+cd/(2k)), E_tr = Int(|cs|/|1+lam s|+|cd|/(1+2 lam k)), remainder bound = Int(|cs|/(lam|s||1+lam s|)+|cd|/(2 lam k(1+2 lam k))); u = 2*|A-B| + residual(A) + decimal rounding; aggregated outputs use the aggregated complex coefficients in the envelopes
method.storage: values: decimal strings of 40 significant digits (envelopes 20); u: decimal strings rounded up; the rounding of the stored decimal is inside u
